referenceSelection.inputFrame: JPL ICRF equatorial vectors, treated as ICRS/GCRS-aligned directions for the orientation transform
referenceSelection.outputFrame: true tropical ecliptic/equinox of date via ERFA IAU2006/2000A with frame bias (trueOfDateICRS)
referenceSelection.observationClock: ISO Z labels are synthetic UT1; TT=encoded UT1+69 seconds at every epoch; not physical historical/future UTC
referenceSelection.requestedReferenceTimeScale: TT; returned raw tables must explicitly identify JDTT; Horizons handles TT/TDB internally
referenceSelection.corrections: Moon: instantaneous geometric NONE; all other selected bodies: JPL LT+S light-time and stellar aberration; no gravitational light bending
referenceSelection.targetCenters: Sun/Moon/Mercury/Venus body centers; Mars through Pluto planetary-system barycenters
referenceSelection.comparisonMeaning: reference-normalized residuals under stated conventions; not a causal decomposition or proof of physical accuracy

implementation.planetCorrection: astronomy-engine 2.1.19 first-order apparent approximation, with retarded heliocentric target and Earth
implementation.axes: astronomy-engine EQJ/FK5 approximation; not an exact ICRF assertion
implementation.centers: approximate provider coefficients; physical-center guarantee not established

knownDifferences: Planet correction differs from standard JPL LT+S.
Approximate orientation differs from independent ERFA trueOfDateICRS.
Outer-planet reference uses system barycenters; provider coefficients do not establish exact center equivalence.

review.reviewer: Codex research source review of the frozen rc.10 artifact
review.notes: This declares the previously examined source conventions for a baseline self-comparison. It is not candidate approval, publisher authentication, Swiss equivalence or a certified accuracy statement.
